config.chat.provider: Provider for the **chat** model. `local` = Ollama / LM Studio / llama.cpp on your machine or your server: no data leaves the network.
config.completion.provider: Provider for **inline completion**. Keep it `local`: this is the number-one cost driver elsewhere (one request per keystroke pause).
config.completion.debounceMs: Idle time before a completion is requested.
config.endpoints.local: URL of the local OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama: .../v1, LM Studio: http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1, vLLM, llama.cpp…).
config.endpoints.openaiCompatible: URL of an internal OpenAI-compatible gateway (corporate proxy, Azure, LiteLLM…).
config.privacy.redaction:
Pseudonymisation before any **remote** request:
- `strict`: credentials, identities, machines, paths, internal URLs, IP addresses — reversibly replaced.
- `balanced`: credentials and identities only.
- `off`: none (discouraged, and it requires `privacy.allowUnredacted`).
config.privacy.allowUnredacted: Actually honour the “off” level. Without this box ticked, “off” falls back to “balanced”.
config.privacy.blockedGlobs: Files that NEVER reach a remote provider, whatever else is configured.
config.privacy.egressPolicy: Confirm before the first remote request of a session (ask-once), before every request (ask-always), or never (trust).
config.privacy.auditLog: Log every remote request locally (timestamp, provider, model, tokens, cost). Never the content.
config.budget.perRequestUsd: Maximum estimated cost of one remote request. Beyond it, the request is refused.
config.budget.dailyUsd: Daily cap on remote spending. 0 = no cap.
config.context.maxTokens: Token budget for the context sent to the model (repository map + excerpts).
config.context.repoMap: Attach a map of the repository's symbols rather than whole files.
config.privacy.customTerms: Organisation-specific words to always replace before a remote request: client names, project names, internal brands.
config.escalation.policy: When the local model is not enough (context too large, a diagnosis or architecture question): `never` refuses, `ask` offers, `auto` switches to the escalation model on its own.
config.language: Interface language. `auto` follows the editor's display language.
